dct_title_s: The Bansa, or residence of the King of Kongo called St. Salvador from Dapper
dct_description_sm: Relief shown pictorially.  Includes illustrations and indexes of points of interest, including "A. King's Palace ; B. Churches ; C. Portugueze fort ; D. Spring well ; E. Slaves carrying water to the city." "The river Lelunda".
"No. 96" (bottom left).  "Plate XVI. Vol. III. p.245." (bottom right).
